summary: Iteration 193 backend testing of post-signup onboarding endpoints. All 5 new pytest onboarding tests pass, all 57 pytest tests in requested regression set pass, and 10 live HTTP integration tests against the public URL pass (auth required, shape correct, idempotent complete, login user_response now includes onboarding_completed, existing admin alpha-daytrader endpoints + google session 400 all regression-clean).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/onboarding.py:60 — `fresh` guarded with `(fresh or {}).get(...)`, so the endpoint tolerates a deleted user gracefully. Good.
routes/onboarding.py:49-56 — broker_connections read wrapped in bare Exception; deliberate degradation per spec. Confirmed via test_status_survives_broker_read_failure.

Login response is flat (user fields + access_token at top level), not nested under `user`. Any frontend or test consumer must read `onboarding_completed` from the top-level of /api/auth/login body. Non-blocking, but worth noting for consistency.
seed_data_creation: none (used admin user; onboarding_completed was toggled true→true during idempotency test, ending state: onboarding_completed=true, stage='completed')
context_for_next_testing_agent: Onboarding endpoints /api/onboarding/status and /api/onboarding/complete are live and stable. Live integration test file at /app/backend/tests/test_onboarding_live_integration.py can be reused for regression. Note the login response shape is flat (not {user:{...}, token:''}) — the fixture derefs `data.get('user') or data`.
